title: The lowest note
summary: Whatever note is lowest decides how the chord sounds.

steps.title: Bass note
steps.body:
The lowest note of a chord as you play it is its **bass note**. In root position the bass note is the root; in an inversion it is another chord tone. A slash chord names it: C/G means a C chord with G as its bass note.

**Why it matters:** The bass note shapes how a chord feels more than any other note. In a band the bass player usually plays it, so keep your left hand from clashing with theirs.

steps.title: C/G
steps.body: A C chord over G: second inversion, written as a slash chord.
